== Course of events ==

The Queen, whose violent nature is evident in her swift and terrible pronouncements, sentences the gardeners to execution. Yet Alice, moved by courage and resolve, rescues the gardeners by placing them within a flower-pot, thereby preventing the Queen's sentence.

The gardeners' rescue does nothing to temper the Queen's violence. When the Queen arrives at the garden with her grand procession, Alice finds herself forced to continue playing croquet whilst the Queen goes on to sentence the other players to execution. The gardeners are safe within their flower-pot refuge, though the Queen's violent judgments now fall upon other players instead.
